eligibility.quote: On 3dsensor.launch, depthimage_to_laserscan looks for depth/image_raw topic, but if we are using depth_registration (the default behavior) it will not work because in this case depth image topic is depth_registered/image_raw.

loudness.quote: depthimage_to_laserscan starves if depth_registration is true (issue title; the failure mode is silent starvation with no diagnostic anywhere in the source; loudness null in the spec conforms to the ineligible-case schema)

resolution.quote: https://github.com/turtlebot/turtlebot/commit/3e32933c829e308600707a9f971334d13d1cbe19 should have resolved this issue. (jihoonl comment; recorded in the spec's E1 evidence; resolution status itself is null, conforming to the ineligible-case schema)

notes: Independently verified: issue #103 (corot, 2013-10-16, 'depthimage_to_laserscan starves if depth_registration is true') body matches the spec quote verbatim (read via gh api); jihoonl's 2015-03-24 closing comment matches; robinJKU's comment linking ros-drivers/openni_launch#7 ('I think this is a more complicated issue: https://github.com/ros-drivers/openni_launch/issues/7') matches, supporting the spec's note that it is a separate composition not addressed by this fix. Commit 3e32933c829e308600707a9f971334d13d1cbe19 (2014-04-02, parent b26d199a18d350e72495c4d8935e5b1ccc64d75a, both confirmed via commits API; patch read in full) changes exactly one file, turtlebot_bringup/launch/3dsensor.launch: adds '+  <arg     if="$(arg depth_registration)" name="depth" value="depth_registered" />' and '+  <arg unless="$(arg depth_registration)" name="depth" value="depth" />' and changes the two remaps from '-      <remap from="image" to="$(arg camera)/depth/image_raw"/>' to '+      <remap from="image" to="$(arg camera)/$(arg depth)/image_raw"/>' (and the second remap from "$(arg camera)/image" likewise); the patch context shows the parent's '<arg name="depth_registration"              default="true"/>'. E2 walk independently: the wrong topic name crosses the boundary (consumer starves), so not internal at step 2; at step 3 the minimal resolving change only rebinds launch-file topic remaps — depthimage_to_laserscan still consumes 'image', the openni pipeline still publishes its depth_registered output under the same names, no unit's declared or referenced interface changed — deployment_wiring. The spec filling E3 (PAIR) and E4 (starvation = no data) beyond the E2 stop is harmless bookkeeping. Agree.
